about: Hand-written synthetic retrieval set (P1, 2026-10-22). Memories are the facts the engine would store; each query lists the memory keys a correct search must return (any order). Hard negatives about other people are generated by eval/e2/retrieval.ts from a fixed seed. Not yet spot-checked by the owner.

categories.paraphrase: query shares few words with the memory
categories.keyword: rare token decides it: codes, numbers, product or place names
categories.entity: about a named person; distractors say the same kind of thing about other people
categories.temporal: query phrased with time words; memory carries a date
